title: Personalized 3D Race Map | Custom GPX Running Wall Art | Marathon Finisher Gift
descriptionHtml:
The course. The city. The finish you earned—given dimension.

Turn your race into a personalized 3D map—framed running wall art built from your recorded GPX route or a verified published course. Choose Gallery or Nocturne, then select your raised route accent: Signal Orange, Volt Lime, Pulse Pink, or Match My Medal (+$29).

Trace preserves more than the route you ran. It brings together the course, the surrounding city, and the performance details that made the day yours. Each piece is individually composed, 3D printed, mounted, framed, and inspected by hand.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

• One finished 11 × 14 in portrait shadow-box display
• A dimensional city/map layer, approximately 8 × 10 in
• A raised route in your selected accent color
• A personalized Race Day poster composition
• A black frame with protective glazing
• A digital proof before final production
• Hand assembly, inspection, and protective packaging

CHOOSE YOUR FINISH

GALLERY — Warm, architectural, and daylight-oriented. An off-white composition and light stone map create a clean gallery presentation.

NOCTURNE — Dark, technical, and dramatic. A charcoal composition and graphite-toned infrastructure create a moodier presentation.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE ACCENT

Choose Signal Orange, Volt Lime, or Pulse Pink for the highlighted route. An option to match a color in your race medal is available for an additional fee. Colors may appear slightly different across screens, printed paper, filament, and room lighting.

HOW YOUR ROUTE IS CREATED

OPTION 1 — UPLOAD YOUR GPX

After purchase, you’ll receive a secure intake form through Etsy Messages. You can upload a GPX file, share a public activity or route link, or provide the race details so I can locate a reliable published course.

OPTION 2 — I DON’T HAVE THE GPX

Buying a gift or unable to access the activity? Provide the race name, location, year, and distance. I’ll look for a reliable published course and confirm it in your proof. A sourced course represents the official published route and may differ from the runner’s exact GPS recording.

If a reliable course cannot be found, I’ll contact you before production to discuss the available options.

PERSONALIZATION

Please provide:

• Runner’s preferred display name
• Race or event name
• Race date and location
• Distance
• Official finish time
• Bib number, if desired
• GPX file or known-race information

Please enter all information exactly as you want it displayed. If a field does not apply, enter “N/A.”

YOUR DIGITAL PROOF

A clean digital preview is normally sent through Etsy Messages within 1–2 business days. Please check the route, crop, orientation, spelling, date, location, statistics, finish, and accent color.

One consolidated correction round is included. Reply “APPROVED FOR PRODUCTION” when everything is correct. Production begins only after written approval. Please respond within 48 hours to protect the estimated shipping date; delayed approval may delay shipment.

MATERIALS AND CONSTRUCTION

The dimensional map and route are 3D printed in PLA. The finished artwork also includes a professionally printed paper composition, backing and mounting materials, a shadow-box frame, and protective glazing. This piece is not ceramic, concrete, stone, or metal.

Because each map is fabricated at a small physical scale, buildings, roads, shorelines, and terrain may be simplified for strength and visual clarity. Trace is commemorative artwork—not a navigation, survey, or engineering map.

PROCESSING AND SHIPPING

A digital proof is normally sent through Etsy Messages within 1–2 business days after your completed intake is received. Once you provide written approval, allow 10–14 business days for printing, mounting, framing, inspection, packaging, and shipment preparation.

The frame is packed with face protection, a protective sleeve, corner cushioning, and a fitted shipping carton. Please retain all packaging until you have inspected the piece.

DIGITAL PRIVACY

GPX files can contain precise location and activity information. Your file is used only to design and fulfill your artwork, is not published or reused, and is handled according to Teklo Studio’s route-data retention policy. Never send account passwords or login credentials.

GIFT ORDERS

You do not need access to the recipient’s fitness account. Send the race name, city, year, and distance, and I’ll determine whether a reliable published course is available. Gift notes may be included at checkout.

IMPORTANT

• This listing is for one physical, framed, personalized artwork.
• The frame is included.
• The launch orientation is portrait only.
• Gallery and Nocturne examples may use different cities and routes.
• Exact structures and route presentation depend on the available geographic and GPX data.
• Screen colors and physical materials may vary slightly.
• Please review all personalization carefully during proof approval.

Please report transit damage within 14 days of delivery. Include photos of the artwork, exterior carton, interior packaging, and shipping label, and retain all packaging until the issue is resolved.

Questions about your route or ordering as a gift? Send a message before purchasing and include the race name, location, year, and distance.

images.altText: A framed 3D papercity wall art piece celebrating the 2026 Pennant Road Race. The black-framed display features a detailed beige papercity map with an orange route line, a blue and orange ribbon, a commemorative race pin, and printed race details including the name Craig Cummings, number 4023, and official time 00:44:13.
Two framed marathon or 10K race maps displayed on a desk, one for Houston and one for Pennant, each with a ribbon and medal, in a real indoor setting.
